name: Bored Ape Yacht Club
rootCause: On April 25, 2022, attackers compromised Bored Ape Yacht Club’s Instagram account, posting a fake Otherside land mint link. Victims who connected wallets and approved safeTransferFrom or setApprovalForAll unknowingly let attackers transfer valuable NFTs from their accounts. The estimated loss is between $2.7 million and $13.7 million, depending on the valuation method. Attackers gained control of BAYC's official Instagram account and posted a fraudulent airdrop/mint link.
